$comment: Language models the app can run in the browser. scripts/download-model.mjs downloads them into public/models and copies these settings into public/models/manifest.json, which src/llm/worker.ts reads. 'small' runs on every device (Qwen3.5-0.8B was dropped: about 10× slower in the browser, with no better answers). chatTemplate: variables for the chat template (thinking stays off for option picking). thinking: reason before free-form answers, hidden from the user, at most thinkingBudget tokens. generation: overrides of src/llm/config.ts GENERATION for free-form answers. Also tried in the browser on the same six tasks (three dashboard explanations, three conceptual answers) and dropped: Gemma 3 1B (about twice as slow, invented facts) and LFM2.5-350M (q4 and q8: fast but wrong numbers and invented statistics; q8 was no better than q4, so the errors come from the model's size, not quantization). 'large' (Qwen3-1.7B, desktops with WebGPU fp16): its q4f16 weights are published inside one 1.4 GB .onnx file, which a browser cannot load; splitWeights moves them into 400 MB external data files at download time (scripts/lib/split-onnx.mjs). Another model can be tried by adding it here and opening the app with ?model=<key>&dtype=<q4f16|q4|q8>.
